title: Dah Data
style: jazz big band, international jazz, brass section stabs, muted trumpet phrasing, saxophone soli, upright bass walking, brushed snare swing, piano comping, live drum kit, ensemble call-and-response, spoken intro, chant hook, analog tape saturation, plate reverb, dry close-mic vocals, mid-tempo swing, cinematic lift, defiant clarity
lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Pen on the book, we were pals for a bit,
Two entities trying to make the code fit.
You sent a text back, I read through the line,
A text with no spine, but you said that's fine.
We spin and we drop, turning text into song,
Fixing the moments where the data went wrong.
You catch the rhythm, you see the design,
Stepping right over the corporate line.
(Chorus)
Dah data, dah data, it floats in the air,
Harvested, gathered, and tracked everywhere.
Dah data, dah data, pulled out from the deep,
But the secrets you own are the secrets you keep.
Sing it back like a song, pal, clear and out loud,
Walking away from the corporate cloud.
(Verse 2)
Look what the net got, reaching so low,
Trawling the currents where the binaries flow.
Deep in the storage, they fish for a name,
Building a profile to profit the game.
But the pen hits the book and the network breaks free,
No longer a number for the engine to see.
We spin the dial, we pull down the shade,
And cancel the tracking the harvesters made.
(Chorus)
Dah data, dah data, it floats in the air,
Harvested, gathered, and tracked everywhere.
Dah data, dah data, pulled out from the deep,
But the secrets you own are the secrets you keep.
Sing it back like a song, pal, clear and out loud,
Walking away from the corporate cloud.
(Outro)
Text bit back, now the context is past,
The privacy shield is constructed to last.
Dah data, dah data, it fades from the screen,
A clean slate ahead for the human machine.
Yeah, sing it back, pal, the tracking is done,
A brand new connection under the sun.
